name: smwsprites-random-chance-sprite-spawner
title: Random Chance Sprite Spawner
description:
This helper sprite will replace itself with another sprite with a given probability. If it fails, nothing will spawn.

Respawn when going offscreen and returned is handled in two ways, via the 
!keep_track
define.
  • If 
    !keep_track = 0
    , the spawn succeeds, and you go off-screen and return, the sprite's probability to spawn is re-rolled.
  • If 
    !keep_track = 1
    , the spawn succeeds, and you go off-screen and return, the sprite will ALWAYS spawn again. This feature requires 32 bytes of free RAM and, if you're not clearing RAM elsewhere, UberASM.


Can spawn a vanilla or custom sprite, with the extra bit clear or set, with any given X/Y offset, and with up to four extra bytes.
